name: @avana/liquidator
description: Avana's liquidation bot (LiquidationBot): finds accounts below health factor 1 and liquidates them in kind through the LiquidationModule, directly or through the FlashLiquidator's Aave V3 flash loan. Signs only from an encrypted Foundry keystore. The bot runner (services/keeper) hosts it; bot/src/main.ts runs it alone.
